factors.name: components
factors.question: List the project components (short name of each component).

factors.name: implementing_agencies
factors.question: List the agencies or entities responsible for implementing the project.
factors.keywords: implementing agenc|implementing entit|executing agenc|project implementation unit|\bPIU\b|\bPMU\b|implementation unit|responsible for implementation

factors.name: cofinanciers
factors.question: List the other financiers or donors co-financing the project (not the Bank, not the government).

factors.name: first_operation
factors.question: Is this described as the first Bank operation in this sector, with this agency, or in this country?
factors.keywords: first (?:bank|ida|world bank)?\s*(?:operation|project|engagement|loan|credit)|first time|no previous|new to the bank

factors.name: follow_on_phase
factors.question: Is the project a second (or later) phase, a follow-on, or part of an APL series?

factors.name: reform_to_adopt
factors.question: Does the project depend on a law, regulation, decree or reform that must still be adopted (e.g. a condition of effectiveness or disbursement)?
factors.keywords: \blaw\b|legislation|decree|regulation|condition of effectiveness|effectiveness condition|disbursement condition|prior action|adoption of

factors.name: env_category
factors.question: What environmental assessment category is the project assigned?

factors.name: overall_risk_rating
factors.question: What overall risk rating does the document give the project?

factors.name: fiduciary_risk
factors.question: What risk rating is given to financial management or procurement?
factors.keywords: financial management risk|procurement risk|fiduciary risk|(?:financial management|procurement)[^.]{0,60}(?:rated|risk is|assessed)

factors.name: baseline_values
factors.question: Do the results / outcome indicators have baseline values stated?

factors.name: lessons_problems
factors.question: Do the lessons learned mention a previous project that performed poorly, failed, or was rated unsatisfactory?

factors.name: fragility_conflict
factors.question: Is the country or project area described as fragile, in conflict, or post-conflict?

factors.name: weak_capacity
factors.question: Does the document state that the implementing agency has weak or limited capacity?
factors.keywords: weak capacity|limited capacity|capacity constraint|lack of capacity|capacity is (?:weak|limited)|insufficient capacity|capacity weakness

factors.name: counterpart_funding
factors.question: Is government counterpart funding required for the project?
factors.keywords: counterpart fund|government contribution|counterpart contribution|borrower contribution|co-financing by the government

factors.name: resettlement
factors.question: Is the involuntary resettlement safeguard triggered, or is land acquisition or resettlement expected?

factors.name: decentralized_implementation
factors.question: Is implementation decentralized to many local or sub-national entities (municipalities, provinces, communities)?

factors.name: pilot_innovative
factors.question: Is the project described as a pilot or as an innovative approach new to the country?

factors.name: political_risk
factors.question: Does the document list political risk, elections, or weak government commitment as a risk?

factors.name: economic_return_reported
factors.question: Does the document report an economic rate of return, net present value or cost-benefit result?
factors.keywords: economic rate of return|\bERR\b|\bEIRR\b|net present value|\bNPV\b|cost-benefit|benefit-cost|internal rate of return
